content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make an ice cream cake, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Soften the vanilla ice cream (20 minutes)
Step 2. Spread the final layer of frosting (15 minutes)
Step 3. Crush chocolate sandwich cookies for the filling (10 minutes)
Step 4. Prepare the springform pan base (5 minutes)
Step 5. Swirl caramel sauce into the softened ice cream (5 minutes)
Step 6. Take the ice cream out of the deep freezer (10 minutes)
Step 7. Clear a level space in the freezer for the pan (5 minutes)
Step 8. Freeze the first layer until firm (2 hours)
Step 9. Purchase premium heavy whipping cream (30 minutes)
Step 10. Chill the mixing bowl and beaters (1 hour)
Step 11. Prepare the decorative piping bags (10 minutes)
Step 12. Whip the heavy cream to stiff peaks (8 minutes)
Step 13. Mix cocoa powder into the whipped cream (5 minutes)
Step 14. Add chocolate sprinkles to the top (2 minutes)
Step 15. Fold in powdered sugar (4 minutes)
Step 16. Measure the fudge sauce (2 minutes)
Step 17. Stir in chopped pecans (5 minutes)
Step 18. Clean the mixing spatulas (5 minutes)

Step 20. Grate dark chocolate for garnish (10 minutes)
Step 21. Place the birthday candles (1 minute)
Step 22. Inventory the pantry for dry ingredients (10 minutes)
Step 23. Layer the cookie crumbs over the first ice cream layer (5 minutes)
Step 24. Read the entire recipe thoroughly (15 minutes)
Step 25. Select a serving platter (5 minutes)
Step 26. Melt butter for the cookie crust (3 minutes)
Step 27. Freeze the assembled cake for the penultimate set (4 hours)
Step 28. Buy a fresh tub of strawberry ice cream (45 minutes)
Step 29. Organize the kitchen workspace (20 minutes)
Step 30. Sharpen the cake knife (5 minutes)
Step 31. Set the kitchen timer (1 minute)
Step 32. Release the sides of the springform pan (2 minutes)
Step 33. Prepare a hot water bath for the knife (3 minutes)
Step 34. Check the freezer temperature (1 minute)
Step 35. Soften the strawberry ice cream (15 minutes)
Step 36. Smooth the top surface with an offset spatula (5 minutes)
Step 37. Wipe down the counter (10 minutes)
Step 38. Take a photo of the finished cake (2 minutes)
Step 39. Print out the decoration reference photo (2 minutes)
Step 40. Put on a clean apron (1 minute)
Step 41. Spread the second flavor of ice cream (10 minutes)
Step 42. Press the crust into the bottom of the pan (8 minutes)
Step 43. Mix the melted butter with cookie crumbs (5 minutes)
Step 44. Locate the electric hand mixer (5 minutes)
Step 45. Chill the serving platter in the fridge (30 minutes)
Step 46. Write a "Happy Birthday" message in chocolate (10 minutes)
Step 47. Prepare a workspace for the fudge layer (5 minutes)
Step 48. Microwave the fudge sauce until pourable (45 seconds)
Step 49. Apply a thin crumb coat of frosting (15 minutes)
Step 50. Wash the fruit for garnish (10 minutes)
Step 51. Spread the fudge sauce over the crumbs (5 minutes)
Step 52. Wrap the cake in plastic wrap for long-term storage (5 minutes)
Step 53. Slice the cake into portions (10 minutes)
Step 54. Whip the topping until fluffy (10 minutes)
Step 55. Let the cake temper on the counter before serving (10 minutes)
Step 56. Sift the decorative cocoa powder (3 minutes)
Step 57. Return the cake to the freezer for the final hardening (6 hours)
Step 58. Place the cake in a cardboard cake box (2 minutes)
Step 59. Confirm the guest count (5 minutes)
Step 60. Serve the cake on individual plates (5 minutes)
Step 61. Clear the dining table (10 minutes)
Step 62. Pour the first ice cream layer into the pan (5 minutes)
Step 63. Prepare the whipped cream frosting (12 minutes)
Step 64. Line the pan with parchment paper (4 minutes)
Step 65. Pipe decorative borders around the edges (20 minutes)
Step 66. Tie back hair for food safety (1 minute)
Step 67. Apply the second layer of ice cream (10 minutes)
Step 68. Remove the parchment paper lining (2 minutes)
Step 69. Clean the cake stand (5 minutes)
Step 70. Put the leftover cake back in the freezer (2 minutes)
Step 71. Slice fresh strawberries (10 minutes)
Step 72. Double check the ingredient expiration dates (5 minutes)
Step 73. Chill the whisk attachment (15 minutes)
Step 74. Flatten the crust with the bottom of a glass (3 minutes)
Step 75. Add a layer of maraschino cherries (5 minutes)
Step 76. Toast the almond slivers (8 minutes)
Step 77. Shop for all necessary groceries (1 hour)
Step 78. Clear the kitchen sink (15 minutes)
Step 79. Sanitize the prep area (10 minutes)
Step 80. Prepare the stabilizing gelatin (5 minutes)
